title: Population-scale breast cancer evidence
summary: Retrospective evidence generation across a 942,124-patient breast cancer study population.
fields: ConcertAI RWD360 combines EHR, claims and curated data for retrospective oncology research.
Define clinically meaningful recurrence and treatment patterns in heterogeneous longitudinal records.
Corresponding author of the study manuscript, currently in preparation; development of analytical approaches and data-quality audits.
Composite recurrence endpoints, treatment and line-of-therapy classification, Cox proportional hazards models, Kaplan–Meier analysis and Fine–Gray competing risks analysis.
942,124 patients in the study population. This is the study’s population scale, rather than a claim of prospective recruitment.
An integrated analytical framework connecting endpoint construction, survival analysis and assessment of misclassification. Manuscript in preparation.
Fit-for-purpose assessment, endpoint validity and data-quality review are integral to interpretation. Individual patient records and unpublished results are not shared here.
